notes:
Account background: Verve Customer Labs is a mid-tier CCaaS provider with 1,200+ employees and a large North American customer base. They have an existing pilot with Redwood for knowledge-search embeddings and now want to expand to live contact-center workloads (agent assist + automated ticket summarization + tool-calling).

Key quotes and context:
- VP Support: "need zero-surprise hallucinations on tool calls, must have immutable audit trail".
- Head of Platform: "we will run 500-1,500 concurrent agent sessions during peak; tail latency matters more than median".
- Procurement: "finalizing legal for EU residency clause, PO expected after that".

Technical requirements summary:
- Workloads: streaming agent-assist (real-time transcripts -> model), post-call ticket summarization (batch + embeddings), reranking for suggested KB articles, safe tool-calling to CRM + billing systems.
- Latency SLOs: 95th pct tail < 250ms for short completions (context window ~1k tokens), streaming latency target ~120-200ms per chunk.
- Throughput: support for burst to 1,500 concurrent agent sessions with graceful degradation and fallbacks.
- Cost sensitivity: looking to compare Dedicated vs Private for unit economics during sustained peaks; Optimize suggestions (quantization, batching, cache policies) expected to reduce token spend ~20-40%.
- Security/compliance: strict EU data residency for EU customers, SSO/SAML, KMS key control, audit logs for tool calls, 12-month retention for transcripts (configurable).

POC notes (current evaluation):
- POC scope: 50 agents on Dedicated pool (single-region NA) for 4 weeks, include tool-calling integration to their internal CRM sandbox, end-to-end latency/cost report.
- Metrics to validate: mean and 95p tail latency for streaming, tokens per session, failure-rate on tool calls, incorrect action rate, cost per completed ticket.
- Security steps completed: SOC2 evidence shared (drive:/security/verve/soc2_evidence.zip), initial pen-test scheduling for Private deployment if procurement approves.

Commercial notes and asks:
- Pricing ask: committed monthly baseline for Dedicated with burst credits; discount matrix for 12- and 24-month term.
- Finance wants ARR banding before legal signs. Current estimate: 150k-500k ARR depending on regions onboarded.

Concise next steps (sales playbook):
- 1) Finalize EU data residency addendum with legal (owner: Jordan).
- 2) Deliver Dedicated POC baseline benchmarks by 2026-03-20 (SE: Maya).
- 3) Follow up with procurement to get PO once legal signoff is complete (CSM: Luis).
